Subsystem: the fashion-case accessory/wallpaper board. Items are sprite nodes in circular doubly-linked lists per page slot. List 0 has 14 accessory pages (6-ish ids per page via the 022484E8 cascade), list 1 has 2 wallpaper pages (slot/9), list 2 has 1, list 3 has 1. Page swap uses a SysTask (0x30 env, HEAP_ID_13) that slides the old page's nodes down 0x2c px/frame for 3 frames and brings in the new page, which was pre-shifted by -0x84, while ov41_022488D8 scrolls the BG. Heap ids: HEAP_ID_13 for task/anims, HEAP_ID_14 (0xe) for node arrays. Touch hitbox region: top 0x12, bottom 0x8f, left 0x0a, right 0x76 (width 0x6c, height 0x7d; matches the random placement ranges in ov41_02248584).
